verses.translation: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
And when the mountains are removed

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when full-term she-camels[1865] are neglected
verses.footnotes: [1865]- Those ten months pregnant and nearing delivery. This verse alludes to distraction from the most valued of possessions.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the seas are filled with flame[1866]
verses.footnotes: [1866]- Or "when the seas have overflowed [into each other]."

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the souls are paired[1867]
verses.footnotes: [1867]- With another like soul. It can also mean "joined" (with their groups or sects) .

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: For what sin she was killed

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the pages[1868] are spread [i.e., made public]
verses.footnotes: [1868]- On which are recorded the deeds of all people.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when the sky is stripped away

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And when Paradise is brought near,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].[1869]
verses.footnotes: [1869]- i.e., all of one's deeds from worldly life, which have accompanied the soul to the Hereafter.

verses.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars -
Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]
And by the night as it closes in[1870]
verses.footnotes: [1870]- An alternative meaning is "as it departs."

verses.translation: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
[That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

verses.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
verses.translation: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.[1871]
And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.[1872]
verses.footnotes: [1872]- i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote to 53:6.

verses.translation: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.[1873]
verses.footnotes: [1873]- Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) did not withhold that knowledge of the unseen which Allāh had revealed to him in the Qur’ān.

verses.translation: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
So where are you going?[1874]
verses.footnotes: [1874]- In your denial of the Qur’ān and in your accusations against the Prophet (ﷺ) . The meaning is essentially "Surely, you have strayed far from Allāh's path."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translation: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
